titulo.estudio: Lire un menu : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Reading a menu: vocabulary and forms

intro: Identify dishes, drinks and simple options on a café menu. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Identify dishes, drinks and simple options on a café menu. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: « Avec » introduces accompaniments and « ou » presents an alternative; prices are read next to the dish. In this passage, «menu» means «menu».

frases.estudio: Le menu comprend une salade ou un sandwich, avec une boisson.

frases.alumno: The chocolate cake is served after lunch.
